content: {"rule": "K-C", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "the sign itself does not state the mechanism", "why": "When [DR3]'s pressed witnesses (the sign's own bounds, Isaiah 7:16, 8:3-4, 8:8) are the pressing side's own chain read together, the rule requires weighing chain against chain by footing, but the judge instead retired to the verse-by-verse stating-verse test ("the sign itself does not state the mechanism"), which K-C says is retired at the judge's seat for either side."}
